YOU WERE INVITED

A friend wants you training on Isofit.

Isofit is a workout tracker: a fast set-by-set logger, a body graph that shows where your training actually lands, and Atlas, a personal AI fitness coach that reads your workout history with your permission. Coming soon to iPhone and the web. Join the waitlist below and we will email you once, when Isofit launches.

Curious what you are signing up for? Start with the features.

COMING SOON TO IPHONE AND THE WEB.

Your workouts, working for you.

Both apps are coming soon. Join the waitlist and we will email you once, when Isofit launches.

FOR
Adults, 18 and over

Apple, Google or email
